name: Gewie SMP
description:
Welcome to ParrotPals, a community-driven Survival Minecraft server where you can build, explore, and team up with other players! Create epic bases, grind resources, trade, and make new friends in a fun and active world. The server focuses on a friendly community and balanced survival gameplay so everyone can enjoy the adventure.

You can even join and play with a live TikTok streamer — captionthism8! Sometimes the streamer is online interacting with players and hanging out with the community, making the experience even more fun.

If you're looking for a chill survival server with an active community, ParrotPals is the place for you. Jump in, start your journey, and become part of the ParrotPals world today!
